-Or06AmKuA31e7ojFkqv.ingredients:
2 tbsp groundnut oil
500g beef mince (12% fat recommended)
1 onion, finely chopped
3 cloves garlic, finely chopped
1 inch ginger, finely chopped
2 dried red chillies, crushed (or flakes)
2 tsp Sichuan peppercorns
4 tbsp Shaoxing rice wine
3 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp dark soy sauce
1 tbsp Sriracha
2 tsp white wine vinegar
Light soy sauce to taste (1-2 tsp)
Chilli crisp oil to taste
2 spring onions, finely chopped (garnish)
Sesame seeds (optional garnish)
-Or06AmKuA31e7ojFkqv.instructions:
1. Heat oil in large frying pan/wok over high heat. Add beef, leave 3-4 minutes until golden. Turn and cook another 1-2 minutes until crispy. Remove from pan.

2. Reduce heat slightly, add onion with additional oil if needed. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes until golden. Add garlic and ginger, stir-fry 1 minute until fragrant. Add red chillies and Sichuan peppercorns, stir-fry 10 seconds.

3. Pour in Shaoxing rice wine, cook 1-2 minutes stirring occasionally until alcohol aroma dissipates.

4. Return beef with resting juices, break up completely. Add oyster sauce, dark soy, sriracha, vinegar, light soy, and chilli crisp. Add 2 tablespoons water, stir-fry 1-2 minutes.

5. Divide among four plates, top with spring onions and sesame seeds. Serve with rice.
-Or06AmKuA31e7ojFkqv.name: Crispy Chilli Beef
-Or06AmKuA31e7ojFkqv.notes: Use mince with some fat (12%) for best flavor and juiciness. Leaner options work if preferred.

-Or0BDv7UBXo2p36NCyz.ingredients:
1 tsp olive oil
1 kg chicken thighs (skin on, bone in)
1 onion, finely chopped
6 cloves garlic, thinly sliced
380ml white wine
200g asparagus, cut into 1/2 cm pieces
100g sugar snap peas, thinly sliced
120g crème fraîche
Handful of finely chopped chives
Salt and pepper to taste
-Or0BDv7UBXo2p36NCyz.instructions:
1. Heat oil in casserole over medium heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Place skin-side down, cook 8-10 minutes until golden. Turn and cook another 5-6 minutes. Remove and set aside.

2. Add onion and garlic with salt and pepper. Cook 6-8 minutes until lightly golden. Pour in wine and deglaze. Return chicken with juices. Cover, reduce heat to low, cook 50-60 minutes until cooked through. Remove lid, increase heat slightly, cook 15 minutes to reduce sauce.

3. Remove chicken, cover to keep warm. Increase heat and cook 10-12 minutes to reduce sauce by half.

4. Blanch asparagus 1 minute in boiling water. Add peas, cook 1-2 minutes until tender. Drain and cool with cold water.

5. Stir crème fraîche into sauce and bring to boil. Add vegetables, stir together. Return chicken to pan and serve immediately.
-Or0BDv7UBXo2p36NCyz.name: Spring Chicken Casserole
-Or0BDv7UBXo2p36NCyz.notes: Serve with tagliatelle, buttery new potatoes, or a leafy green salad. Double cream can substitute for crème fraîche.

-Or0DW5CnXynfR2cf7Qi.ingredients:
120g broccoli florets
400g cooked udon noodles
1 tbsp neutral oil
300g chicken thigh or breast, very thinly sliced
2 cloves garlic, finely chopped
2 tbsp sriracha
2 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp dark soy sauce
2 spring onions, finely chopped
-Or0DW5CnXynfR2cf7Qi.instructions:
1. Boil broccoli for 2-3 minutes until tender, remove with spoon. Add noodles to boiling water for about one minute until separated. Drain and rinse with cold water.

2. Heat oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Cook chicken for 3-4 minutes until done. Add garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds until fragrant.

3. Add broccoli and noodles to the pan with sriracha, oyster sauce, and soy sauce. Stir-fry until everything is coated. Divide between two bowls and garnish with spring onions.
-Or0DW5CnXynfR2cf7Qi.name: Easy Udon Chicken Noodles

-Or0E-YdH6mL1rtKYcDC.ingredients:
2 tbsp rose harissa, plus extra for serving
3 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
1 cauliflower, cut into florets
1 red onion, finely sliced
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
Juice of 1 orange
300g Greek yogurt
Handful of finely chopped parsley leaves
30g pomegranate seeds
Sea salt to taste
-Or0E-YdH6mL1rtKYcDC.instructions:
1. Heat oven to 200°C fan. Combine harissa, olive oil, and salt; toss with cauliflower florets in a roasting tray. Roast for 30-35 minutes until charred and tender.

2. Mix orange juice into the bowl containing leftover harissa oil mixture; set aside.

3. Combine sliced red onion with vinegar and salt in a separate bowl. Toss periodically for about 10 minutes until the onion turns pink.

4. Drizzle the orange-harissa mixture over the hot roasted cauliflower.

5. Spread yogurt on serving plate, swirl in additional harissa if desired. Top with cauliflower, then scatter onions, parsley, and pomegranate seeds over the top. Serve immediately.
-Or0E-YdH6mL1rtKYcDC.name: Harissa Roasted Cauliflower
-Or0E-YdH6mL1rtKYcDC.notes: Serves 4 as a main. Great with flatbread on the side.

-Or0EHV0i8BxA4FG-4tE.ingredients:
500g peeled carrots, cut in half lengthways
2 tbsp olive oil
1½ tbsp rose harissa
1 tbsp runny honey
400g tin chickpeas, drained (reserve water)
2 cloves garlic
Juice of ½ lemon
100ml tahini
10g toasted pine nuts
Small handful finely chopped coriander leaves
Salt to taste
-Or0EHV0i8BxA4FG-4tE.instructions:
1. Heat oven to 200°C fan. Place carrots in baking tray with half the oil and salt. Roast 25 minutes until nearly cooked (quarter large carrots lengthways first).

2. Mix rose harissa with honey and remaining oil. Drizzle three-quarters over carrots, toss, and roast another 5-6 minutes until sticky.

3. Blend drained chickpeas with garlic, lemon juice, tahini, salt, and 100ml reserved chickpea water until smooth. Add more chickpea water if needed.

4. Swirl hummus onto plate, pile carrots in center, drizzle remaining harissa, garnish with pine nuts and coriander.
-Or0EHV0i8BxA4FG-4tE.name: Sticky Harissa Carrots with Hummus
-Or0EHV0i8BxA4FG-4tE.notes: Homemade hummus is part of the recipe. Pairs well with the Harissa Roasted Cauliflower.

-Or0FPrK0TI-GGzjAIlL.ingredients:
2 huge tomatoes
1/2 red onion
80g pitted black olives
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp olive oil
Juice of 1 lemon
1/2 tsp dried oregano
100g feta
Salt and pepper to taste
-Or0FPrK0TI-GGzjAIlL.instructions:
1. Slice the tomatoes and arrange on a plate with red onion and black olives.

2. Crush garlic and combine with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and oregano; whisk together.

3. Drizzle dressing over salad and crumble feta on top.
-Or0FPrK0TI-GGzjAIlL.name: Tomato and Feta Salad
-Or0FPrK0TI-GGzjAIlL.notes: Inspired by Greek taverna salads. Use the ripest tomatoes you can find.

-Or0Fa1LqK2N6-dhQlaW.ingredients:
2 tbsp oil
2 tsp cumin seeds
2 large onions, finely chopped
4 cloves garlic, crushed
1 inch ginger, grated
2 tsp garam masala
1 tsp chilli powder
1 x 400ml tin coconut milk
3 tbsp tomato puree
2 x 400g tins chickpeas, drained
Juice of ¼ lime
Small handful finely chopped coriander leaves
Salt to taste
-Or0Fa1LqK2N6-dhQlaW.instructions:
1. Heat oil in large shallow pan over medium heat. Add cumin seeds and crackle for 20 seconds until fragrant. Add onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 18-20 minutes until very soft.

2. Add garlic, ginger, garam masala, chilli powder, and salt. Mix for 10 seconds until fragrant. Pour in coconut milk and tomato puree, then add chickpeas. Cover, reduce heat to low, and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.

3. Remove lid, increase heat slightly to gentle bubble. Cook 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens. Add lime juice and taste. Adjust salt and lime as needed. Serve with coriander.
-Or0Fa1LqK2N6-dhQlaW.name: Creamy Chickpea Curry
-Or0Fa1LqK2N6-dhQlaW.notes: Accidentally vegan! Can be cooked ahead and frozen. Serve with rice or naan.

-Or0GHWZBsJCuOPDdMZz.ingredients:
1 cauliflower, cut into florets (600g) and leaves
4 tbsp olive oil
2 tsp baharat
1 large tomato
Juice of 1 lemon
100ml tahini
1 clove garlic, crushed
30g shelled pistachios, roughly chopped
Small handful of finely chopped parsley leaves
2 tsp Turkish pepper flakes
Salt to taste
-Or0GHWZBsJCuOPDdMZz.instructions:
1. Heat oven to 200°C fan. Combine cauliflower florets with 2 tbsp olive oil, baharat, and salt in a roasting dish. Roast 30-35 minutes until charred and tender.

2. Grate the tomato using the coarse side of a cheese grater over a bowl to extract pulp and juice. Discard skin. Whisk juice with remaining olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

3. In another bowl, combine tahini with garlic, lemon juice, 100ml water, and salt. Whisk until smooth and thickened.

4. Plate by swirling tahini dressing onto surface. Arrange roasted cauliflower on top. Drizzle remaining tahini and tomato dressing. Garnish with pistachios, parsley, and pepper flakes.
-Or0GHWZBsJCuOPDdMZz.name: Roasted Cauliflower Salad
-Or0GHWZBsJCuOPDdMZz.notes: Uses baharat spice blend. Grating the tomato for the dressing is a great technique.

-Or0GnopjbMKiwHcemo7.ingredients:
600g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 1-2cm strips
1 tbsp corn flour
1 tsp light soy sauce
1 tbsp rice wine
4 tbsp groundnut oil
1 onion, thinly sliced
4 cloves garlic, roughly chopped
3 spring onions, cut into 2-inch pieces lengthways
½ inch ginger, finely chopped
1 tsp Sichuan peppercorns
6 dried chillies, halved
60g cashew nuts
2 tbsp oyster sauce
1 tbsp dark soy
1 tbsp chilli sauce
2 tsp white wine vinegar
Small handful of coriander leaves
-Or0GnopjbMKiwHcemo7.instructions:
1. Coat chicken with corn flour, light soy, and rice wine; set aside.

2. Heat half the oil in wok over high heat; stir-fry onion 2-3 minutes until golden. Add garlic, spring onions, ginger, Sichuan pepper, and dried chillies; cook 1 minute. Transfer to plate.

3. Add remaining oil to wok; cook chicken 5-6 minutes until done. Add cashew nuts; stir-fry 1 minute.

4. Return vegetables to pan; stir 30 seconds. Add oyster sauce, soy, chilli sauce, and vinegar. Add water if needed. Toss in coriander and serve.
-Or0GnopjbMKiwHcemo7.name: Chicken with Cashew Nuts
-Or0GnopjbMKiwHcemo7.notes: Sichuan-style stir-fry inspired by travels to Chengdu. Serve with steamed rice.

-Or0HDU2Mo8UYDSykQk9.ingredients:
For the dumplings:
500g minced pork (5-10% fat)
1 egg
2 spring onions, finely chopped
Small handful finely chopped coriander leaves and stalks
1 red chilli, grated or finely chopped
¼ inch ginger, grated or finely chopped
3 cloves garlic, grated or finely chopped
1 tbsp water
1 tbsp light soy sauce
1 tbsp rice wine
1 pack gyoza wrappers
Pinch of salt

For the dipping sauce:
2 tbsp crispy chilli oil (Laoganma recommended)
3 tbsp dark soy
2 tsp light soy
2 tsp white wine vinegar
2 spring onions, finely chopped
1 red chilli, finely chopped (optional)
-Or0HDU2Mo8UYDSykQk9.instructions:
1. Combine pork, egg, spring onions, coriander, chilli, ginger, garlic, water, soy sauce, rice wine, and salt in a bowl. Mix thoroughly until the pork goes a little sticky.

2. Wet your finger, rub around wrapper edges, add 15g filling to center, fold into semi-circle, and seal tightly. Pleat edges if desired. Repeat.

3. Whisk all dipping sauce ingredients together.

4. Boil dumplings in batches for 4-5 minutes until they float. Remove with slotted spoon, drain excess water, place in bowls, top with sauce, and serve.
-Or0HDU2Mo8UYDSykQk9.name: Chilli-Garlic Pork Dumplings
-Or0HDU2Mo8UYDSykQk9.notes: Great weekend project. Can freeze uncooked dumplings on a tray then bag them. Laoganma chilli crisp oil recommended for the sauce.

-Or0HPukZIU6gCQtqWCq.ingredients:
1 red onion, thinly sliced
Juice of 3 limes
850g watermelon, cut into 2cm cubes
250g cucumber, cut into 1-inch cubes
200g feta cheese, cubed
Large handful of fresh mint leaves, roughly chopped
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
-Or0HPukZIU6gCQtqWCq.instructions:
1. Slice the red onion thinly and place in a bowl with lime juice and salt. Allow to sit for 10 minutes to lightly pickle while preparing other ingredients.

2. Combine watermelon, cucumber, feta, mint, olive oil, and remaining lime juice in a serving dish with a pinch of salt. Toss gently, top with pickled onions, and serve right away.
-Or0HPukZIU6gCQtqWCq.name: Watermelon and Feta Salad
-Or0HPukZIU6gCQtqWCq.notes: Perfect for beating the heat. Serve immediately -- doesn't keep well.

-Or0H_Kr0TOVB_Irs-WD.ingredients:
1 x 400g tin chickpeas, drained and dried
2 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
2 tsp smoked paprika
2 tsp garlic powder
2 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp chilli flakes
200g feta
110g yogurt
1 clove garlic
Zest of ½ lemon
Salt to taste
-Or0H_Kr0TOVB_Irs-WD.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C fan. Combine chickpeas with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, dried oregano, chilli flakes, and salt. Spread on roasting tray and roast 20-25 minutes until crispy.

2. Blend feta with yogurt, garlic, and lemon zest in food processor until smooth. Season with salt as needed.

3. Plate the whipped feta mixture, top with roasted chickpeas, drizzle with oil, and serve immediately.
-Or0H_Kr0TOVB_Irs-WD.name: Whipped Feta with Spiced Chickpeas
-Or0H_Kr0TOVB_Irs-WD.notes: Great as a starter or snack with warm flatbread. Make sure chickpeas are dried well before roasting for maximum crispiness.

-Or0IIr7YOPnaKOc49OZ.ingredients:
For the dressing:
Juice of 1 orange
1 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
2 tsp Dijon mustard
Salt and pepper

For the salad:
250g cooked beetroots, peeled and chunked
200g cooked green lentils (tinned)
150g cherry tomatoes, halved
4 spring onions, finely sliced
25g shelled pistachios, roughly chopped
100g feta cheese, crumbled
Large handful fresh mint leaves, torn
Large handful rocket leaves
Salt and pepper
-Or0IIr7YOPnaKOc49OZ.instructions:
1. Whisk together orange juice, olive oil, vinegar, and mustard with salt and pepper to create dressing.

2. Combine beetroots, lentils, tomatoes, spring onions, pistachios, feta, mint, and rocket in a serving bowl. Pour dressing over, toss together, and serve immediately.
-Or0IIr7YOPnaKOc49OZ.name: Beetroot and Feta Salad
-Or0IIr7YOPnaKOc49OZ.notes: Easiest throw-together salad. Use pre-cooked beetroots and tinned lentils for zero cooking.

-Or0IcuRoCVwzSceKFku.ingredients:
For the chicken:
6 cloves garlic
2 inches ginger
600g chicken thigh fillets
50g Greek yogurt
Juice of ½ lemon
2 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder
Salt to taste

For the sauce:
40g butter
4 cardamom pods
2-inch cinnamon stick
2 onions, finely chopped
1 inch ginger, grated
4 cloves garlic, crushed
2 tsp Kashmiri chilli powder
2 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp fenugreek leaves
2 tbsp tomato puree
250ml double cream
Juice of ½ lemon
100ml water
Rice for serving
-Or0IcuRoCVwzSceKFku.instructions:
1. Grate garlic and ginger; mix together.

2. Marinate chicken with yogurt, lemon juice, chilli powder, salt, and half the ginger-garlic paste. Leave 1 hour or overnight.

3. Heat butter in pan; add cardamom, cinnamon, and onions; cook 18-20 minutes until golden.

4. Add remaining ginger-garlic paste and salt; cook 30 seconds. Add spices and tomato puree; stir in cream, lemon, and water.

5. Grill marinated chicken 3-4 minutes per side until charred; slice and add to sauce with resting juices.

6. Serve immediately with rice.
-Or0IcuRoCVwzSceKFku.name: Butter Chicken
-Or0IcuRoCVwzSceKFku.notes: Marinate overnight for best results. Kashmiri chilli powder gives colour without too much heat. Grilling the chicken adds a nice char.

-Or0J32IuUfG62IeNjQj.ingredients:
100g Greek yogurt
2 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for drizzling
6 cloves garlic, crushed
Juice of 1 lime
2 tsp ground fenugreek
2 tsp fine ground black pepper
1 tsp turmeric
600g chicken thighs, cut into 1-inch cubes
Sea salt

To serve:
1 red onion, finely chopped
Handful of parsley, finely chopped
Juice of ½ lemon
1 baby gem lettuce, roughly chopped
2 tomatoes, roughly chopped
Yogurt, pickles, chilli sauce, rice or bread
-Or0J32IuUfG62IeNjQj.instructions:
1. Combine yogurt, olive oil, garlic, lime juice, fenugreek, black pepper, turmeric, and salt in a bowl. Add chicken and coat thoroughly. Marinate for 30 minutes or overnight.

2. Preheat oven to 220°C fan. Thread chicken onto four skewers (soak wooden skewers 10 minutes first). Place on grill rack and cook 10-12 minutes until done. Season with additional salt.

3. Mix red onion and parsley with lemon juice and salt.

4. Serve kebabs with salad, pickles, chilli sauce, and rice or bread.
-Or0J32IuUfG62IeNjQj.name: Black Pepper & Fenugreek Chicken Kebabs
-Or0J32IuUfG62IeNjQj.notes: Marinate overnight for best results. Works great on a BBQ grill too.

-Or0JK-_dAshMfYRogd_.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
900g lamb leg, cut into 2-3 inch chunks
2 onions, finely sliced
1 x 400g tin chopped tomatoes
2 tbsp tomato puree
1 tsp ground black pepper
1 tsp ground cinnamon
½ tsp turmeric
A pinch of saffron
250g split peas, washed and drained
400ml chicken or lamb stock
Juice of ½ lime
Small handful of parsley leaves
Salt to taste
Rice for serving
-Or0JK-_dAshMfYRogd_.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 180°C fan. Heat oil in a casserole over medium-high heat. Season meat and brown in two batches, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove and set aside.

2. Reduce heat to medium. Add onions, mixing well. Cook 5-6 minutes until softened, deglazing pan if needed.

3. Add tomatoes, tomato puree, pepper, cinnamon, turmeric, saffron, lamb, split peas, stock, and salt. Cover and braise in oven for 1¼ – 1½ hours until meat is tender and peas cooked. Add water if dry.

4. Stir in lime juice and parsley. Check seasoning. Serve immediately with rice.
-Or0JK-_dAshMfYRogd_.name: Persian Lamb & Split Pea Stew
-Or0JK-_dAshMfYRogd_.notes: Also called Khoresht Ghaimeh. A classic Persian stew. The saffron and cinnamon make it special. Serve with basmati rice.

-Or0LQ-ZsoMShuzB6n05.ingredients:
3 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for greasing
2 onions, peeled and sliced into rings
2 preserved lemons, halved
1.5kg free range chicken
A large bunch of parsley leaves
A large bunch of coriander
2 cloves garlic
2 green chillies
Juice of 1 lemon
3 tbsp white wine vinegar
A large glass of white wine
300g giant couscous or orzo
20g butter
Salt
-Or0LQ-ZsoMShuzB6n05.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C fan. Oil a roasting tray and add sliced onions as a base. Place preserved lemons in chicken cavity, rub with 1 tbsp olive oil, season with salt. Roast for 1¼–1½ hours until cooked through and juices run clear.

2. For zhoug: blend parsley, coriander, garlic, chillies, lemon juice, 2 tbsp vinegar, remaining oil, salt, and 80-100ml water until smooth.

3. Boil couscous 8-10 minutes or as directed on pack until tender; drain. (Or cook orzo al dente.)

4. Remove chicken from tray. Add wine and remaining vinegar to pan, heat, and deglaze. Transfer to saucepan, simmer 2-3 minutes until alcohol smell disappears. Whisk in butter and salt.

5. Serve couscous in large dish, pour sauce over, mix well. Top with sliced chicken, drizzle remaining sauce, serve with zhoug.
-Or0LQ-ZsoMShuzB6n05.name: Roast Chicken with Zhoug & Giant Couscous
-Or0LQ-ZsoMShuzB6n05.notes: Zhoug is a Yemeni green chilli sauce. Can substitute giant couscous with orzo. Great for Sunday dinner or entertaining.

-Or0MX-j9X9nrUoO1iPp.ingredients:
1 kg chicken thighs (skin and bone on)
2 red onions, quartered
8 cloves garlic
4 tbsp rose harissa
1 tbsp olive oil
125ml white wine
1 x 400g tin butterbeans, drained
½ lemon, juiced
50g feta
Small handful of finely chopped dill
Sea salt to taste
-Or0MX-j9X9nrUoO1iPp.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 200°C fan. Combine chicken thighs, red onions, garlic, rose harissa, and olive oil in a bowl. Season with salt. Transfer to roasting tray, pour wine over, and roast 40-45 minutes until chicken is crispy and tender.

2. Add drained butterbeans to the tray along with lemon juice. Toss gently, cover with foil, and rest for 5 minutes.

3. Transfer chicken to serving dish, spoon pan juices over top, crumble feta over, scatter dill, and serve immediately.
-Or0MX-j9X9nrUoO1iPp.name: Harissa Roasted Chicken Traybake
-Or0MX-j9X9nrUoO1iPp.notes: One-pan wonder. The butterbeans soak up the harissa juices. Minimal cleanup.

-Or0MrM8AwungBuG9YlL.ingredients:
600g cauliflower florets
500g chicken thigh fillets
80g yogurt
Juice of 2 lemons
2 tbsp tikka paste
4 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp cider vinegar
2 handfuls of mint leaves
2 green chillies
Sea salt
-Or0MrM8AwungBuG9YlL.instructions:
1. Heat oven to 200°C fan. Toss cauliflower with half the olive oil and salt in a roasting tray. Roast for 20 minutes.

2. Combine chicken thighs, yogurt, tikka paste, lemon juice, and salt in a bowl; mix thoroughly.

3. Add chicken mixture to the cauliflower tray and bake another 25-30 minutes until golden and cooked through.

4. While cooking, blend mint, chillies, vinegar, remaining olive oil, and salt into a smooth chutney. Serve alongside.
-Or0MrM8AwungBuG9YlL.name: Indian Chicken Traybake
-Or0MrM8AwungBuG9YlL.notes: No tikka paste? Mix 2 tbsp tomato puree with 1 tsp ground cumin and ground coriander. Serve with wraps, yogurt, or rice.

-Or0NKaXAuKLms6j-cqE.ingredients:
1 kg peeled watermelon, cut into chunks
Juice of 4 limes
4 tsp caster sugar
120ml tequila
60ml Cointreau or orange juice
4 sprigs mint
Plenty of ice
-Or0NKaXAuKLms6j-cqE.instructions:
1. Blend the watermelon chunks and pour juice into a jug (strain if desired to remove seeds).

2. Add lime juice, sugar, tequila, and Cointreau to the jug and mix well.

3. Place mint sprigs in four glasses, fill with ice, pour cocktail over top, and serve immediately.
-Or0NKaXAuKLms6j-cqE.name: Watermelon Margarita
-Or0NKaXAuKLms6j-cqE.notes: Can substitute Cointreau with orange juice for a lighter version. Straining seeds is optional.

-Or0NoVDm9Pupr1g-EOi.ingredients:
1 onion, roughly chopped
1 tin chopped tomatoes
4 cloves garlic
1 inch peeled ginger
30g cashew nuts
3 tsp garam masala
1 tsp ground fenugreek
1 tsp chilli powder
600g boneless skinless chicken thigh fillets
3 tbsp Greek yogurt
Juice of 1½ limes
120ml coconut cream
A handful of coriander leaves
Rice and breads to serve
Salt to taste
-Or0NoVDm9Pupr1g-EOi.instructions:
1. Combine onion, tomatoes, garlic, ginger, cashew nuts, 2 tsp garam masala, fenugreek, and chilli powder in blender until smooth. Transfer to saucepan and add 200ml water.

2. Bring to boil over medium heat, cover, reduce heat to low, and simmer 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until thick and rich.

3. Meanwhile, preheat grill to high. Toss chicken with yogurt, lime juice, remaining garam masala, and salt. Grill 4-5 minutes per side until golden.

4. Slice chicken into bite-sized pieces, add to sauce with remaining lime juice and coconut cream. Serve with rice, breads, and coriander garnish.
-Or0NoVDm9Pupr1g-EOi.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
-Or0NoVDm9Pupr1g-EOi.notes: Can prep ahead -- marinate chicken overnight and make sauce a day in advance. Cashew nuts make the sauce extra creamy.

-OrSuMbgUoMaRGBLoVZW.ingredients:
3 lbs red new potatoes, washed and quartered
1/2 medium red onion, thinly sliced
2 bunches asparagus tips (the top 1-2 inches of each stalk)
1  radish, thinly sliced
1/3 cup fresh dill, roughly chopped
1/2 cup mayo
1 tbsp coarse grain mustard
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp lemon zest
1-2  lemons, juiced
2-3 tbsp honey
-OrSuMbgUoMaRGBLoVZW.instructions:
1. Bring a pot of water to boil, seasoned heavily with salt and 2-3 tbsp of vinegar. Add the quartered potatoes and boil for 15 minutes. Drain and let cool for 10 minutes. Add to a large bowl with the sliced onion and toss to combine. Let sit another 10 minutes.

2. In the pot of boiling water, add the asparagus tips and cook for 2 minutes. Remove to an ice bath immediately and cool. Add to the potatoes, along with the fresh dill and toss to combine.

3. In a bowl, whisk together all of the dressing ingredients. Add half of the dressing to the potatoes and toss to coat. Allow to sit a few minutes, and add more dressing as desired. Add the sliced radish and serve at room temperature.
-OrSuMbgUoMaRGBLoVZW.name: The Best (Non-Traditional) Potato Salad Recipe

-OrZ9KZVTndK3uGdF5It.ingredients:
3 cups (375g) all-purpose flour (spooned & leveled)
2 teaspoons cream of tartar*
1 teaspoon baking soda
1 and 1/2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
1/2 teaspoon salt
1 cup (16 Tbsp; 226g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
1 and 1/3 cup (267g) granulated sugar
1 large egg + 1 large egg yolk, at room temperature
2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract
1/3 cup (70g) granulated sugar
1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
-OrZ9KZVTndK3uGdF5It.instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Line two large cookie sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats (always recommended for cookies). Set aside.

2. Whisk the flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt together in a medium bowl.

3. In a large bowl using a hand mixer or stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat the butter and granulated sugar together on high speed until smooth and creamy, about 2 minutes. Add the egg, egg yolk, and vanilla extract. Beat on medium-high speed until combined. Scrape down the sides and up the bottom of the bowl with a rubber spatula as needed. With the mixer running on low speed, slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients in 3 different parts. The dough will be thick.

4. Combine the granulated sugar and cinnamon together in a small bowl.

5. Roll cookie dough into balls, about 1.5 Tablespoons (35g) of cookie dough each. I recommend this cookie scoop. Roll the dough balls in cinnamon-sugar topping. Sprinkle extra cinnamon-sugar on top if desired. Arrange 3 inches apart on the baking sheets.

6. Bake cookies for 10 minutes. The cookies will be very puffy and soft. When they are still very warm, lightly press down on them with the back of a spoon or fork to help flatten them out. Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 10 minutes and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

7. Cookies remain soft & fresh for 7 days in an airtight container at room temperature.
-OrZ9KZVTndK3uGdF5It.name: Soft; Thick Snickerdoodles

-OrZBdqeJeEe_W-AGJdP.ingredients:
8 ounces dried udon noodles
1/2 cup tamari or soy sauce
3-4 tablespoons chili paste
2 tablespoons rice vinegar
2 tablespoons lemon juice
2 tablespoons honey
2 tablespoons toasted sesame oil
6 cloves garlic, chopped
1 tablespoon fresh chopped ginger
1 pound thinly sliced chicken breasts, thighs, or ground chicken
2 cups frozen stir fry veggies
1/4 cup chopped scallions
2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds
1/4 cup fresh chopped cilantro/ThaI basil, for serving
-OrZBdqeJeEe_W-AGJdP.instructions: 1. 1. Cook the udon noodles according to package directions. 2. Combine the soy sauce, chili paste, rice vinegar, honey, toasted sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and 1/4 cup water in a bowl. 3. Cook the chicken with 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Season with black pepper. Add the mixed stir fry veggies and cook another 2-3 minutes. Slowly pour in the sauce mix and scallions. Bring to a low simmer. Add the noodles and cook until the sauce coats the chicken and noodles.4. Serve the noodles warm, topped with sesame seeds and fresh chopped herbs. Enjoy!
-OrZBdqeJeEe_W-AGJdP.name: 20 Minute Honey Garlic Chicken Udon Noodles

-OrZCn1iP8gBiQyKG7pS.ingredients:
1kg higher-welfare beef brisket
2 bay leaves
1 teaspoon cumin seeds
1 teaspoon coriander seeds
1 teaspoon chilli powder
1 tablespoon plain flour
olive oil
2 x 400g tins of quality plum tomatoes
1 x 500g bag of frozen soffrito mix
2 x 400g tins of black beans
500ml organic beef stock
-OrZCn1iP8gBiQyKG7pS.instructions:
1. Cut the brisket into 2–3cm chunks.

2. Strip the bay leaves into a pestle and mortar, removing their stems. Add the cumin and coriander seeds, chilli powder and a pinch of sea salt, and bash until fine. Muddle in the flour.

3. Rub the super-charged seasoned flour all over the beef brisket chunks, making sure they’re well coated.

4. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of olive oil into a wide, low-sided pan on a medium heat. Once hot, add the beef and cook for 8 to 10 minutes, or until well browned all over.

5. Transfer to your slow cooker*, scraping in all the crispy bits from the bottom of the pan. Scrunch in the tomatoes with your hands, then add the soffrito mix, black beans (juice and all) and beef stock.

6. Mix well, cover, then cook on low for 8 to 12 hours, or until tender. Delicious served with soured cream, pickled red onions and fresh coriander.
-OrZCn1iP8gBiQyKG7pS.name: Slow-cooker chilli con carne

-OrZD514EfkpMesQTjhH.ingredients:
4 higher-welfare pork sausages or veggie sausages
4 sprigs of rosemary or 2 teaspoons fennel seeds
2 cloves of garlic
olive oil
320g fresh or frozen chopped mixed onion, carrot & celery
1 x 400g tin of chickpeas
2 x 400g tins of quality plum tomatoes
450g pasta shells
optional: Parmesan cheese, for grating
-OrZD514EfkpMesQTjhH.instructions:
1. Place a large shallow casserole pan on a medium-high heat. Squeeze the sausage meat out of the skins into the pan, breaking it up with a wooden spoon and fry until lightly golden, stirring regularly. (If using veggie sausages, roughly slice and fry in 1 tablespoon of olive oil until golden and crispy.)

2. Pick and roughly chop the rosemary leaves and peel and finely slice the garlic. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of oil into the pan then add the chopped mixed veg, rosemary and garlic. Season to perfection, then mash everything together with a masher and cook for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until softened.

3. Pour in the chickpeas, juice and all, and scrunch in the tomatoes along with 1 tin’s worth of water, mashing everything up until fine. Bring to the boil, then reduce to a medium-low heat and simmer for 30 minutes, until thick and delicious, mashing everything up with a potato masher.

4. When the sauce has around 12 minutes remaining, cook the pasta in a pan of boiling salted water according to the packet instructions, then drain, reserving a mugful of the starchy cooking water.

5. Toss the cooked pasta into the sauce, adding splashes of the water to loosen if needed, then divide between bowls. Grate over a little Parmesan and drizzle with a little olive oil, if you like, and serve.
-OrZD514EfkpMesQTjhH.name: Simple sausage pasta

-OsMH2cJcf0vEMlzb9rm.ingredients:
⅔ cup (95g) all-purpose flour
1 tbsp (6g) cocoa powder (I prefer this Dutch cocoa or this one)
¼ tsp baking powder
6 oz (170g) bittersweet chocolate (70% cocoa),
⅓ cup (75g) unsalted butter
2  large eggs, (warmed under warm running water)
¾ cup plus 2 tbsp (175g) granulated sugar
½ tsp pure vanilla extract
½ tsp salt
-OsMH2cJcf0vEMlzb9rm.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F. Line two large cookie sheets with parchment paper.

2. Sift flour, cocoa powder and baking powder into a medium bowl and whisk to blend evenly.

3. Combine chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl and melt in the microwave in 30 seconds bursts with frequent stirring, or melt in a saucepan over low heat while stirring constantly until completely smooth and glossy. Set this aside but keep it warm - no need to cool it down.

4. Crack the eggs into a medium bowl. Gradually add sugar while mixing with an electric handheld mixer on medium speed. Once all of the sugar is combined, continue mixing for 2 minutes until lightened and pale yellow-colored. If whisking by hand, then whisk vigorously for 2-3 minutes. When you rub the mixture between your fingertips, it should feel like much of the sugar is dissolved, with a few gritty granules.

5. Add melted chocolate mixture, vanilla and salt and whisk it in until evenly combined. The batter will tighten up and become glossy when the chocolate is properly emulsified. Add the sifted dry ingredients and fold them in gently. At this point, the consistency of the batter highly depends on the temperature of your ingredients and the temperature of your kitchen since it is made of mostly chocolate which has a sharp melting point. If your batter is quite runny, set the bowl aside for 5-10 minutes to thicken up so it looks like pudding, but not too long or it will stiffen up as the cocoa butter sets.

6. Use a 1 ¼-oz cookie scoop to portion batter and release it onto the baking sheets leaving at least 3 inches of space between them. Bake for 7-8 minutes until the edges are set but the middle is still gooey. Let them chill on the tray for 5 minutes since they are delicate while warm and will stick to the parchment if you try to release them too early. Top with flaky sea salt and enjoy!
-OsMH2cJcf0vEMlzb9rm.name: Classic Fudgy Brownie Cookies

-OsaJNrr2NCfbrT10_v2.ingredients:
½ cup (60g)  finely ground roasted salted pistachios
1 cup (142g) all-purpose flour
1 teaspoon baking powder
¼ teaspoon baking soda
¾ cup (150g) granulated sugar
¼ teaspoon salt
¼ cup (60ml) olive oil
1  large egg, (at room temperature)
½ cup (120ml) full fat plain yogurt, (at room temperature)
¼ cup (60ml) whole milk, (at room temperature)
1 tablespoon (15ml) fresh lemon juice
1 teaspoon (5ml) pure vanilla extract
1 cup (120g) powdered confectioner's sugar
1 tablespoon (15ml) plain yogurt
1 tablespoon (15ml) whole milk
¼ tsp pure vanilla extract
chopped pistachios for topping
-OsaJNrr2NCfbrT10_v2.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. Lightly grease an 8-inch round cake pan, dust lightly with flour  The flour helps the batter cling to the sides of the pan to help it climb up and rise higher. Line the base with a round of parchment paper. Sometimes I don’t even grease the sides and let the batter stick and climb up – I never have issues releasing it from the pan with an offset spatula and the cake rises a bit higher.

2. Make the cake batter. Place pistachios with 1 tablespoon of flour into the bowl of a food processor and pulse until it forms fine crumbs. The flour will help prevent it from turning into a paste.

3. Sift remaining flour into a large bowl. Sift in baking powder and baking soda. Add ground pistachios, sugar, and salt and whisk until evenly blended.

4. Combine olive oil, egg, yogurt, milk, lemon juice and vanilla extract in a medium bowl and whisk until completely smooth.

5. Pour the wet ingredients into the bowl with dry ingredients and gently fold it all together being sure to get down to the bottom and bring up any dry pockets. Stop right when the batter is fully combined and be careful not to over mix.

6. Spread batter evenly into the prepared pan using a small offset spatula and bake for about 30-35 minutes until lightly golden and a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean. Let cool for 20 minutes in the pan and then run an offset spatula around the sides of the cake to release it and invert onto a cooling rack to finish cooling.

7. Make the glaze. Combine powdered sugar, milk, yogurt and vanilla in a medium bowl and whisk until completely smooth. Place the cake on a wire rack and set the rack over parchment-lined tray. Pour the glaze over the cake letting it drip over the edges. Scrape up the glaze that drips off the cake onto the parchment and spoon it back over the cake. If you want, you can also add more powdered sugar to make a thicker icing, but I like this donut-glazed effect. Sprinkle some more chopped pistachios over top while the icing is wet and serve immediately or store covered to serve later.
-OsaJNrr2NCfbrT10_v2.name: Olive Oil Pistachio Cake

-OsmLoIoozpqs8F-qALx.ingredients:
1/2 cup softened butter
1 1/4 cups sugar
2 eggs
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
2 cups flour
1/2 teaspoon salt
2 teaspoons baking powder
1/2 cup milk
2 cups blueberries, washed, drained and picked over
3 teaspoons sugar
-OsmLoIoozpqs8F-qALx.instructions:
1. Preheat the oven to 375.

2. Cream the butter and sugar until light.

3. Add the eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add vanilla.

4. Sift together the flour, salt and baking powder, and add to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk.

5. Crush 1/2 cup blueberries with a fork, and mix into the batter. Fold in the remaining whole berries.

6. Line a 12 cup standard muffin tin with cupcake liners, and fill with batter. Sprinkle the 3 teaspoons sugar over the tops of the muffins, and bake at 375 degrees for about 30-35 minutes.

7. Remove muffins from tin and cool at least 30 minutes. Store, uncovered, or the muffins will be too moist the second day, if they last that long.
-OsmLoIoozpqs8F-qALx.name: Jordan Marsh’s Blueberry Muffins

-OsqQdvbkvouZ4Ym20ml.ingredients:
4 (6 ounce) salmon filets, cut into bite-size chunks
1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
1 teaspoon chipotle powder or cayenne
chili flakes
4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
3 cups broccoli florets or chopped asparagus or a mix
avocado wedges + sesame seeds, for serving
1/3 cup tamari or soy sauce
3 tablespoons honey
6 cloves garlic, chopped
1 teaspoon  ground ginger
3-4 tablespoons chili paste
2 tablespoons chopped green onions
1 tablespoon toasted sesame oil
1/2 cup mayo
1-2 tablespoons gochujang
2 teaspoons honey
-OsqQdvbkvouZ4Ym20ml.instructions: 1. 1. Preheat the oven to 450° F. Rub a sheet pan with oil.2. On the sheet pan, mix the salmon, 1/2 teaspoon ginger, the chipotle powder, and chile flakes. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil, tossing to coat. Arrange the salmon to one side of the sheet pan. Add the broccoli/asparagus to the other side. Toss with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Bake for 10-15 minutes until the salmon is cooked to your liking.3. To make the sauce. In a bowl or glass jar, combine all ingredients.4. For the spicy creamy sauce, combine all ingredients. 5. Remove the vegetables from the sheet pan. Then, pour the honey garlic sauce over the salmon and toss it up in the sauce. Bake for another 5 minutes until the sauce is baked onto the salmon.5. Serve the salmon, vegetables, and honey garlic sauce with avocado wedges, green onions, and toasted sesame seeds. I love this over coconut rice.
-OsqQdvbkvouZ4Ym20ml.name: 35 Minute Chili Honey Garlic Salmon Bowls

-OsqdKapNXCopse1sgoH.ingredients:
4 (4-6 ounce)  salmon filets
2-3 tablespoons spicy curry powder  ((homemade in notes) )
kosher salt and black pepper
chili flakes
1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
2 tablespoons honey
6 tablespoons salted butter
1/4 cup Thai red curry paste
1 tablespoon fresh grated ginger
1 1/2 cups chopped broccoli
2 cups canned full-fat coconut milk
2 tablespoons tamari or soy sauce
1 tablespoon fish sauce  ((or soy sauce))
3-4 cloves garlic, chopped
-OsqdKapNXCopse1sgoH.instructions: 1. 1. Preheat the broiler. 2. Place the salmon on a baking sheet and rub with olive oil, curry powder, and season with salt and pepper. Drizzle the honey over the salmon. Broil until crisping on top, 3-5 minutes, watch closely. 3. In a large skillet over medium heat, melt together 1 tablespoon butter, the curry paste, and ginger. Cook, 2-3 minutes until very fragrant. Add the broccoli, coconut milk, tamari or soy sauce, and fish sauce. Slide the salmon into the sauce and simmer for 3-5 minutes, or until cooked to your liking.4. Meanwhile, melt together 5 tablespoons butter, the garlic, and a pinch of chili flakes. Cook until the butter is browning and the garlic crisps. 5. Serve the salmon and sauce over bowls of rice. Drizzle the butter over the salmon and top with basil or cilantro.
-OsqdKapNXCopse1sgoH.name: Coconut Curry Salmon with Garlic Butter

-OtU4sqNSGXJ6SLTp31O.ingredients:
¾ cup (170g) unsalted butter, (softened)
½ cup plus 1 tbsp (115g) granulated sugar
½ cup (110g) packed light brown sugar
1 ½ tsp (7ml) pure vanilla extract
1  large egg, (at room temperature)
1  large egg yolk, (at room temperature)
1 tbsp (15ml) whole milk,  (at room temperature)
2 cups (284g) all-purpose flour
¾ tsp baking powder
½ tsp baking soda
½ tsp salt
½ cup (80g) rainbow jimmies sprinkles (sprinkle rods)
3 tbsp (40g) granulated sugar for rolling  ((optional))
3 tbsp rainbow confetti sprinkles for rolling  ((optional))
-OtU4sqNSGXJ6SLTp31O.instructions:
1. Make the cookie dough. Combine soft butter with both sugars and vanilla in a large bowl and mix with an electric hand mixer on medium-high speed for 1-2 minutes until pale and fluffy. You can also mix by hand using the creaming method with a wide rubber spatula. Add the egg and mix until well incorporated and smooth, then mix in egg yolk and milk.

2. Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl and whisk to blend evenly. Add these dry ingredients to the butter/sugar mixture and fold it in until mostly combined with a few streaks a flour remaining. Add sprinkles and fold them in until evenly combined. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour.

3. Preheat your oven to 350°F. Line two large cookie sheets with parchment paper.

4. Bake the cookies. Use a 1.35-oz cookie scoop to portion dough and roll into smooth balls, then roll the dough balls in granulated sugar so they are evenly coated. Sometimes I skip this step and press the top of the dough balls in confetti sprinkles instead.

5. Place the dough balls onto prepared baking sheets spacing them at least 3 inches apart with room to spread. Bake for 9-12 minutes until puffed and the edges are just lightly golden and the bottoms are lightly browned. The centers will puff up and still feel slightly soft in the middle. They will deflate slightly as they cool. Transfer baking trays to a wire rack to cool for 2 minutes then transfer cookies individually to a wire rack to cool completely.
-OtU4sqNSGXJ6SLTp31O.name: Soft & Chewy Sprinkle Sugar Cookies

-Ow9_IRf6sOQ_O-JA6DZ.ingredients:
300g fresh ricotta, drained, crumbled
170ml full cream milk
4 eggs, separated
130g plain flour
1½ tsp baking powder
unsalted butter, to cook
125g butter
1 Crunchie Chocolate
1 tsp honey
-Ow9_IRf6sOQ_O-JA6DZ.instructions:
1. To make the crunchie butter, finely chop your crunchie, chocolate and all, until nice and fine.
2. Add the Crunchie crumbs to the soft butter, along with the honey, and mix well.

1. Separate the eggs into two very clean and dry mixing bowls. To the egg yolks add the ricotta and milk and mix until well combined. In another bowl sieve in the flour and baking powder. Pour the egg yolk ricotta mixture into the bowl and mix until just combined.
2. Clean and dry the whisk well, then whisk up the egg whites until they form stiff peaks. Spoon half the whipped whites into the batter, then gently fold the mixtures together with a spatula. Repeat with the remaining egg whites.
3. Melt a small knob of butter into a non-stick pan on medium heat. Spoon the batter into the pan in rough circles. Cook the pancakes for about 1 ½ -2 minutes per side, or until they start to set and turn golden brown on the bottom.
4. Stack the pancakes up and serve slathered in crunchie butter.
-Ow9_IRf6sOQ_O-JA6DZ.name: Bill Granger's Pancakes

-OwHh35Y3UtIcFlZl2aC.ingredients:
1 cup cottage cheese, blended smooth
2 tbsp maple syrup or honey
1 1/2 cups almond flour
1/4 cup protein powder
1/4 cup peanut butter (1/2 cup for stronger peanut butter flavor)
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup dark chocolate chips
1 tsp coconut oil
Flaky salt for topping (optional)
-OwHh35Y3UtIcFlZl2aC.instructions:
1. Blend cottage cheese until smooth.
2. Mix cottage cheese, maple syrup or honey, almond flour, protein powder, peanut butter, and salt until a thick dough forms.
3. Roll into balls and freeze for 20-30 minutes.
4. Melt dark chocolate chips with coconut oil.
5. Dip each ball in chocolate, place on parchment, and top with flaky salt if you want.
6. Refrigerate or freeze until set.
-OwHh35Y3UtIcFlZl2aC.name: Cottage Cheese Peanut Butter Balls
-OwHh35Y3UtIcFlZl2aC.notes: Makes ~20 balls. With 1/4 cup peanut butter: ~2,700 cal/batch (~135 cal each). With 1/2 cup peanut butter: ~3,100 cal/batch (~155 cal each). 24 smaller balls = ~115-130 cal each. Calories vary most with the cottage cheese, chocolate chips, protein powder, and ball size.
